pages.raw_meta: Explore UniFirst's locations that provide managed uniform rental and facility services. We offer industry-specific solutions that enhance worker safety, productivity, and professional image.
raw_blocks: For information on how to get started with UniFirst service, or to ask a question, feel free to give us a call. If you prefer, fill out the contact form and one of our representatives will contact you.

If you’re looking for a uniform rental service near you, or if you’re currently using a uniform rental program and are considering switching to UniFirst, we’ve developed a list of frequently asked questions (FAQs) to help you. If you have additional questions, you can contact us at any time. We’re here to always deliver for you.
What types of uniform rental services does UniFirst offer?

UniFirst offers a wide range of uniform rental services customized to meet the needs of various industries. Our program includes hygienic laundering, automatic repairs and replacements to ensure your team always looks professional and feels comfortable. From flame-resistant safety garments and medical scrubs to industrial workwear , we provide high-quality garments for your industry.
What industries do you serve with your uniform rental programs?

UniFirst proudly serves businesses across diverse sectors, including healthcare , automotive , food processing , manufacturing , transportation , energy and utilities , hospitality , and retail . Each industry benefits from our high-quality workwear and dedicated service, helping businesses comply with industry standards while maintaining a professional appearance for employees.
What facility services are included in your rental program?

Our facility service programs include an extensive list of services and products such as mats, mops, towels, restroom essentials ( hand soap , tissues , and air fresheners ), and janitorial supplies. UniFirst takes care of delivery, laundering, and restocking, so your workplace remains clean, safe, and fully equipped.
How does the uniform rental process work?

UniFirst simplifies the uniform rental process by managing everything for you. We start by helping you select uniforms suited to your business and industry. Once chosen, we size your employees to ensure a perfectly fitted uniform. Our service includes weekly pickups of soiled garments, professional laundering, and timely delivery of fresh, clean uniforms. Repairs and replacements are handled seamlessly, reducing your workload so you can focus on more important business.
Can I customize uniforms with my company’s logo and branding?

Yes, UniFirst offers uniform customization options to enhance your business image. Our advanced embroidery services allow you to add your company logo, employee names, emblems, or unique designs to uniforms. Customizing uniforms fosters brand recognition, instills employee pride, and promotes a cohesive team appearance.
What are the benefits of a uniform rental program?

A uniform rental program saves you time, ensures compliance with health and safety standards, and promotes professionalism and team pride. With UniFirst, you eliminate the hassle of purchasing, cleaning, and replacing your own uniforms. Your team gets consistently well-maintained workwear, reinforcing your brand image and creating a safer, professional, and more productive workplace.
How does UniFirst help ensure compliance with industry regulations for uniforms and safety gear?

UniFirst supports regulatory compliance by providing uniforms and safety gear that meet industry standards, such as NFPA for flame resistance or OSHA for workplace safety. Our specialized garments are designed for various needs, including high-visibility and flame protection, ensuring your employees are equipped with the right protection for their roles. We also manage garment maintenance and replacements to ensure your workwear retains its protective qualities and continues performing its intended function effectively.
